name: GFX_hof_ic_malenkow_the_premiership
title: 部长会议主席
concept: A single CLOSED HARD-COVER REGISTER BOOK standing UPRIGHT on a dark wooden desk, its plain cover facing us and COMPLETELY BLANK, no letters, insignia, title, image or emblem. Beside it just a small fan of worn physical index cards, bent edges from long handling. The upright book dominates and feels like the final authority derived from years of card keeping. Natural brown cover, cream worn cards, wood desk; no central red.
prompt: Create ONE finished Hearts of Iron IV Soviet national focus icon. Use attached image ONLY as stylistic reference for the shared outer engraved gold laurel wreath, small red star and blank gold ribbon; create a NEW central scene. A single CLOSED HARD-COVER REGISTER BOOK standing UPRIGHT on a dark wooden desk, its plain cover facing us and COMPLETELY BLANK, no letters, insignia, title, image or emblem. Beside it just a small fan of worn physical index cards, bent edges from long handling. The upright book dominates and feels like the final authority derived from years of card keeping. Natural brown cover, cream worn cards, wood desk; no central red. Central art style: restrained, realistic 1930s-1950s Soviet sculptural relief, tactile wood, aged paper and objects. Color ONLY from depicted objects, never an overall color wash. The outer ornamental star may remain red on all six; within the central scene red is permitted ONLY on the desk stamp for the cadres directorate image and forbidden on all other images. Exactly one centered emblem in square canvas; composition must read clearly at 100x88. TRUE RGBA transparent outside wreath and ribbon, alpha 0 at all four corners, 20-50 percent broad transparent exterior. No legible typography, numerals, watermark, faces, people, uniforms, weapons, executions, prison bars, concentration camp, blacklisted or torn names, Leningrad buildings, German symbols, rockets, mushroom cloud, factory floor, warships, naval chart, hammer-and-sickle portrait, neon or glow. Output one final production icon, not mockup or sheet.
